_comment: BLG-SEC-15 / ST-04 (EPIC-02, v8.5): known-as-of-baseline snapshot for the monthly dependency-vuln-rescan.yml scheduled job. Advisory IDs listed here are treated as 'already tracked' by the workflow's dedup logic and will NOT re-trigger a new GitHub issue on every run -- only advisory IDs absent from this file are reported as 'new'. This is NOT an accepted-risk register (unlike vulnerability-scan.yml's inline CVE-2026-4539 ignore, which has explicit Cybersecurity & Trust Lead + Head of Engineering sign-off) -- these are unreviewed at baseline time and were filed as BLG-SEC-18 for Cybersecurity & Trust Lead triage. Update this file (add the advisory ID) once a finding has been reviewed and is either fixed, or a considered accept-risk decision is recorded elsewhere (e.g. inline in vulnerability-scan.yml per the CVE-2026-4539 pattern) -- do not silently let the baseline grow uncurated. ST-24 (BLG-SEC-18, EPIC-05, v8.8) update, 2026-08-16: react-router/react-router-dom's 12 advisory IDs removed below (genuinely fixed -- react-router-dom upgraded ^7.13.0 -> ^7.18.2, confirmed absent from a fresh npm audit); the remaining 29 IDs (14 packages) are recorded accept-risk per docs/security/npm_audit_baseline_review_2026-08-16.md, review-by 2027-02-16 -- no longer 'unreviewed'. Rescan triage update, 2026-10-06 (GitHub issue #1885, [GOVERNANCE] hotfix): lockfile-only non-breaking remediation (npm audit fix --legacy-peer-deps) plus a compression >=1.8.2 override resolved 23 previously-baselined IDs (shell-quote, websocket-driver, ws, form-data, brace-expansion, fast-uri, nanoid, tar and others -- no longer present at HIGH/CRITICAL, removed below) and 7 newly-disclosed ones; 11 newly-disclosed IDs across 5 react-scripts/tailwindcss build-toolchain packages with no non-breaking fix added below as recorded accept-risk per docs/security/npm_audit_rescan_triage_2026-10-06.md, same 2027-02-16 review-by date.

npm_audit.note: 6 packages carry their own HIGH advisories as of 2026-10-06 (postcss, svgo, webpack-dev-server, webpack-dev-middleware, node-forge, braces); every other HIGH entry in npm audit output inherits from one of these. All are transitive build/dev-toolchain dependencies of react-scripts (CRA v5) or tailwindcss, confirmed never imported by application source and never shipped to the browser. Accept-risk: postcss + svgo GHSA-2p49 per docs/security/npm_audit_baseline_review_2026-08-16.md (ST-24, BLG-SEC-18, v8.8); remaining 11 IDs per docs/security/npm_audit_rescan_triage_2026-10-06.md. Review-by 2027-02-16 for all. Durable fix: CRA -> Vite migration (docs/ops/cra_migration_scoping_2026-09-08.md).
